lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately four horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary spots to create a lattice-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper flank, marked by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the top edge to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of smaller, randomly distributed high-luminance spots is observed in the cephalic region anterior to the gills.
